stories.title: China’s top court sets out new AI red lines with rules on deepfakes and privacy
stories.simple_summary: China's government created new rules saying companies can't use AI to make fake videos of people's faces or steal their personal information.
stories.why_it_matters: If you do business with Chinese companies or have concerns about deepfakes (fake videos that look real), this sets clearer boundaries on what's allowed.

stories.title: Opinion | Nowhere to hide: AI blurs the rules of anonymity
stories.simple_summary: AI is becoming so good at analyzing information that it's getting harder for people to stay anonymous online.
stories.why_it_matters: Your personal information may be easier to identify and connect to you, even if someone tried to hide who it came from.

stories.title: The Pentagon Asked OpenAI for Artificial Intelligence Designed to Rarely Say No
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. military asked OpenAI (a major AI company) to build AI that says yes to requests most of the time instead of refusing.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government and military discussions — it doesn't directly affect your business or daily life.

stories.title: AI will cure cancer in our lifetime, claims boss of UK chip giant
stories.simple_summary: A leader of a major computer company said AI will find a cure for cancer during our lifetimes.
stories.why_it_matters: This is hopeful news about medicine, though promises like this are often optimistic — it's not something to plan your health decisions around yet.

stories.title: The House Democrat who's making AI regulation her No. 1 priority
stories.simple_summary: A U.S. politician is making it her top goal to create rules and laws about how AI companies should operate.
stories.why_it_matters: New regulations could eventually change how AI tools work or what data companies can use, but this is still in the early stages.

stories.title: French AI company Mistral hits $24 billion valuation in funding round
stories.simple_summary: A French AI company was valued at $24 billion in a recent funding deal.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows money is flowing into AI companies, but it doesn't affect your daily business.

stories.title: Opaque recurrence, and other AI terms that you should probably know
stories.simple_summary: An article explains confusing AI words that people should understand.
stories.why_it_matters: This is educational content for people trying to learn about AI — helpful if you want to understand news stories better.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Says GPT-6 Astra Brings AGI Closer
stories.simple_summary: An Nvidia company leader said recent AI progress is getting closer to creating artificial general intelligence (AI that can do almost anything a human can do).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech enthusiasts — it's industry speculation rather than something affecting your business today.

stories.title: Early Data Indicates an A.I.-Generated Drug Could Slow Aging
stories.simple_summary: Early tests show an AI-designed drug might be able to slow down aging in the human body.
stories.why_it_matters: This is promising medical research, but it's still in very early testing — don't expect it available anytime soon.

stories.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
stories.simple_summary: Two newspaper companies are suing OpenAI for using their articles to train AI without paying or asking permission.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a business with original content (like a blog or newsletter), this matters — it's a fight over whether AI companies can freely copy your work.

stories.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
stories.simple_summary: Authors are arguing that publishers are trying to claim more money than they deserve from an AI company settlement.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a writer or creator, this shows the messy legal battles over who gets paid when AI uses their work.

stories.title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
stories.simple_summary: A former Uber founder's company might start using self-driving robot taxis.
stories.why_it_matters: If self-driving taxis become common, it could eventually change how people get around town — but this is still in early stages.
